description: This file contains shell script tests for verifying the behavior of a configuration reading utility, specifically focusing on reading early configuration settings, handling configuration hierarchies, and error conditions in a Git-like environment.

methods.name: test_config
methods.description: Sets up test configuration files with specified parameters.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Runs a block of commands expecting them to succeed.

methods.name: test_expect_failure
methods.description: Runs a block of commands expecting them to fail.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Checks for patterns in output streams.

methods.name: test_with_config
methods.description: Creates a temporary git repository with a given config and tests config reading.

methods.name: nongit
methods.description: Verifies behavior outside a Git repository.
